modelLabel: Gameplay model, not a NASA health or engineering prediction
healthModel: Scores are educational abstractions. Unmet oxygen demand raises oxygen debt; repeated shortages escalate health loss. Food shortage and rationing increase fatigue first; sustained shortage reduces health. Routine modeled radiation never triggers acute illness or death.
pressureModel: Habitat pressure is kPa, outside pressure is Pa. Gameplay safety uses a simplified 70 kPa habitat floor; this is not a NASA medical limit. Habitat nitrogen/oxygen chemistry and decompression dynamics are not modeled.
radiationModel: 0.67 mSv/Earth day is an archived Curiosity RAD average at Gale Crater, Aug 2012–Jun 2013. Converted by solHours/24 for this game only. Shelter/indoor factors and solar-event additions are illustrative assumptions, not measured human doses.
energyModel: HUD energy is stored kWh; facility rates are kWh/sol, not kW. Critical habitats and CO2 removal are served before oxygen, food and research; a player priority can swap food and oxygen. Storage is bounded.
foodModel: 0.62 kg dry food per Earth day is used as a planning assumption; greenhouse yield and water use are gameplay values. Rationing has delayed costs, not instantaneous fatality.
difficultyModel: Difficulty changes resource buffers, event preparation and repair costs only; archived NASA measurements never change.
solarEventModel: Fictional warning adds 2 mSv/sol before shielding and seeded scenario severity. This value is independent of flare classification, is not inferred from SDO or DONKI, and is not a measured Mars dose. The real observation is the historical trigger only.
dustModel: Archived Opportunity tau 10.8 drives exp(-tau × 0.13)/scenario severity, clamped to 18–35% array yield for three sols. The coefficient, clamp, duration and severity are gameplay assumptions; diffuse light and array properties are not modeled.
